sections.title: GREAT LAKES TO NRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: WHILE STRONGEST MID LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN NORTH OF THE U.S. BORDER ACROSS ONTARIO...SRN EXTENT OF LARGE SCALE FORCING SHOULD SPREAD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES DURING THE DAY. LATEST SHORT-RANGE MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS MID LEVEL FLOW WILL INCREASE TO AROUND 50KT ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM SRN WI...ACROSS NRN LOWER MI INTO NRN MAINE BY 20/00Z. THIS BELT OF INCREASING LARGE SCALE FLOW WILL COINCIDE WITH ADVANCING COLD FRONT THAT IS EXPECTED TO ADVANCE ESEWD AHEAD OF PROGRESSIVE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH. EARLY IN THE PERIOD IT APPEARS SCT TSTMS MAY BE NOTED ALONG COLD FRONT FROM SERN MN...NEWD ACROSS NRN WI INTO CNTRL ONTARIO. THIS ACTIVITY COULD BE LOCALLY STRONG AND PERHAPS EVEN PRODUCE MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL OR GUSTY WINDS. HOWEVER...MORE SIGNIFICANT CONVECTION IS EXPECTED LATER IN THE DAY AS BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING IS EXPECTED TO ENHANCE INSTABILITY SUCH THAT ANY STORMS THAT FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT WILL DO SO WITHIN A THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF ROBUST UPDRAFTS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS PORTIONS OF LOWER MI SUGGEST CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES...NEAR 90F...SHOULD BE REACHED AND WITH LOW LEVEL FRONTAL CONVERGENCE SCT THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED BY 19Z. DEEP WLY FLOW AND

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STRONG HEATING ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO DESTABILIZATION ACROSS SERN WY/NERN CO/WRN NEB ALONG FRINGE OF MODEST NWLY FLOW REGIME. WEAK LOW LEVEL UPSLOPE COMPONENT WILL CONTRIBUTE FAVORABLY TO SHEAR PROFILES AND WEAK ORGANIZATION IS POSSIBLE WITH STRONGEST CONVECTION THAT EVOLVES DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT. LOCALLY STRONG DOWNBURSTS OR HAIL COULD ACCOMPANY THE MOST ROBUST CONVECTION.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: WWD MIGRATING UPPER TROUGH IS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS SLOWLY ACROSS LA DURING THE DAY FRIDAY. THIS FEATURE HAS CONTRIBUTED TO SIGNIFICANT DAYTIME CONVECTION OVER THE LAST FEW DAYS...ESPECIALLY AFTER 18Z BENEATH COOLER MID LEVEL TROUGH AXIS...AND STRONG CONVECTION IS ONCE AGAIN EXPECTED DURING THE DAY1 PERIOD. LOCALLY STRONG WET MICROBURSTS ARE POSSIBLE WITHIN VERY MOIST REGIME CHARACTERIZED BY PW VALUES IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES. ..DARROW/DIAL.. 07/19/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A LONG-WAVE TROUGH --ANCHORED BY AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER NWRN QUEBEC-- WILL INTENSIFY ACROSS THE ERN HALF OF CANADA AND THE GREAT LAKES OWING TO THE SEWD PROGRESSION OF A STRONG VORTICITY MAXIMUM CURRENTLY OVER NERN MANITOBA. THIS FEATURE WILL BE PRECEDED BY A WEAKER VORTICITY RIBBON WHICH WILL MOVE FROM NRN MN SEWD THROUGH THE UPPER GREAT LAKES. ELSEWHERE...A MID TO UPPER-LEVEL LOW --COLD CORE IN NATURE-- WILL SLOWLY SHIFT WWD ACROSS LA INTO ERN TX. IN THE LOW LEVELS...THE ERN PORTION OF A COLD FRONT FROM THE MN ARROWHEAD SWWD THROUGH THE MID MO VALLEY INTO CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WILL ADVANCE SEWD THROUGH THE UPPER GREAT LAKES. MEANWHILE...THE WRN SEGMENT WILL MOVE NWD AS A WARM FRONT...EVENTUALLY LINKING WITH A LEE CYCLONE DEVELOPING EWD FROM ERN WY INTO WRN SD.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST/GREAT LAKES THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT
sections.text: DESPITE ONLY MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES PER 12Z SOUNDINGS... ABUNDANT SUNSHINE COUPLED WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S WILL CONTRIBUTE TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS BY AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG. FORCING FOR ASCENT/DCVA ASSOCIATED WITH THE ABOVE-MENTIONED LEAD VORTICITY RIBBON WILL AUGMENT GENERALLY WEAK LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE TO SUPPORT THE INTENSIFICATION OF THE ONGOING PRE-FRONTAL TSTM BAND CURRENTLY FROM THE U.P. OF MI SWWD TO ERN NEB AS OF 12Z. ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS ACTIVITY ALONG DEVELOPING LAKE BREEZE BOUNDARIES AND/OR CONFLUENCE LINES AS WELL AS ALONG THE SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT. GIVEN A DEEP WLY WIND FIELD THAT WILL STEADILY STRENGTHEN THROUGH THE DAY...THE SETUP WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF BOWING LINE SEGMENTS AND EMBEDDED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL. THIS THREAT WILL LIKELY SPREAD EWD INTO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES BY TONIGHT WITH A CONTINUED RISK FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: NRN NEW ENGLAND TODAY AND TONIGHT
sections.text: MULTIPLE ROUNDS OF TSTMS WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING THE FORECAST PERIOD...THE FIRST OF WHICH WILL MOVE ACROSS PARTS OF NRN AND CNTRL MAINE THIS MORNING INTO AFTERNOON. THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ESTABLISHED BY THESE INITIAL STORMS AND THE SYNOPTIC WARM FRONT LIFTING NEWD ACROSS THE REGION WILL LIKELY SERVE AS THE PRIMARY FOCI FOR IN-SITU STORM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY. OTHERWISE...EXPECT STORMS TO EVOLVE ACROSS SWRN PARTS OF ONTARIO AND QUEBEC BEFORE MOVING INTO THE AREA. THE COMBINATION OF MODERATE AMOUNTS OF INSTABILITY AND VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORM MODES...INCLUDING BOWING STRUCTURES AND SUPERCELLS. THE PRIMARY HAZARD WILL BE DAMAGING WINDS...THOUGH SOME HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO ARE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: THE ISALLOBARIC RESPONSE TO THE DEVELOPING WY LEE CYCLONE WILL RESULT IN STRENGTHENING SELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS BY AFTERNOON ALONG WITH THE NWD DEVELOPMENT OF THE SURFACE FRONT. DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER MIXING WILL LIKELY OFFSET ANY MEANINGFUL MOISTURE ADVECTION WITH DEWPOINTS REMAINING IN THE UPPER 40S TO MID 50S. HOWEVER...THE REGION WILL RESIDE ALONG THE ERN FRINGE OF INTERMOUNTAIN WEST EML WHICH WILL SUPPORT MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000-1500 J/KG AMIDST A KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT FEATURING A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH AROUND 35 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. OROGRAPHIC FORCING COUPLED WITH CONVERGENCE INVOF THE SURFACE LOW AND RETREATING FRONT ARE EXPECTED TO FOSTER ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT BY MID TO LATE AFTERNOON...A FEW OF WHICH MAY BECOME SEVERE WITH A RISK FOR HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. OTHER ELEVATED STORMS MAY DEVELOP TO THE NORTH OF THE SURFACE FRONT TONIGHT OVER WRN SD WHERE WAA AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT ARE ENHANCED AT THE TERMINUS OF A NOCTURNAL LOW-LEVEL WIND MAXIMUM. SOME HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS.

sections.title: ERN TX/LA INTO THE OZARK PLATEAU THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: SIMILAR TO PAST DAYS...THE MID TO UPPER-LEVEL LOW MENTIONED IN THE SYNOPSIS WILL INTERACT WITH A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS TO PROMOTE SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS STORMS THROUGH THE PEAK OF THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE. THE STRONGEST STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF WET-MICROBURST-RELATED WIND DAMAGE INTO THIS EVENING. ..MEAD/JIRAK.. 07/19/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST LOW PROBABILITIES FOR SEVERE WIND/HAIL MAY EXIST WITH BROKEN BANDS OF CONVECTION OVERSPREADING LOWER MICHIGAN INTO AND THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS. HOWEVER...THE NEED FOR A SEVERE WEATHER WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...AT LEAST IN THE NEAR TERM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE NOT PARTICULARLY STEEP...BUT SIZABLE MIXED LAYER CAPE STILL APPEARS LIKELY TO CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ACROSS MUCH OF SOUTHERN AND EASTERN LOWER MICHIGAN DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH FURTHER SURFACE HEATING OF A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH DEW POINTS IN THE LOWER 70S. ALTHOUGH THIS WOULD SEEM TO BECOME INCREASINGLY SUPPORTIVE OF SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL IN THE PRESENCE OF STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR BENEATH 30-50 KT CYCLONIC WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW...THE EXTENT OF THIS THREAT REMAINS UNCERTAIN. BOUNDARY LAYER CONVERGENCE REMAINS WEAK ACROSS MUCH OF LOWER MICHIGAN...AHEAD OF THE MAIN COLD FRONT...WHICH IS STILL LOCATED ACROSS THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION...AND MAY NOT IMPACT THE MORE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN LOWER MICHIGAN UNTIL MUCH LATER THIS AFTERNOON OR EVENING. STRONGER MID/UPPER FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION IN THE BROAD WARM SECTOR OF THE SURFACE CYCLONE MIGRATING ACROSS NORTHERN QUEBEC APPEARS LIKELY TO REMAIN ACROSS THE CANADIAN PROVINCES THROUGH MUCH OF THE DAY AS WELL. WHILE ISOLATED STORMS COULD OCCASIONALLY FLARE UP IN ASSOCIATION WITH A BAND OF WEAK TO MODEST MID-LEVEL LARGE SCALE ASCENT...NOW OVERSPREADING NORTHERN LOWER MICHIGAN...AND POSSIBLY IMPACTING THE MICHIGAN THUMB AND SOUTHEASTERN LOWER MICHIGAN THROUGH 18-21Z...SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL STILL SEEMS TOO LOW/SPARSE IN NATURE TO REQUIRE A WW AT LEAST IN THE NEAR TERM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: IT IS NOT CERTAIN THAT A WATCH WILL BE NEEDED...BUT IT DOES NOT APPEAR OUT OF THE QUESTION THAT CONVECTION COULD INCREASE AND INTENSIFY SUFFICIENTLY TO WARRANT A WATCH. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THIS POSSIBILITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ANOTHER BAND OF STRONGER MID/UPPER FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION APPEARS TO BE AIDING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT NEAR THE SURFACE FRONT...AND PERHAPS A PRE-FRONTAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...NOW ADVANCING SOUTH SOUTHEASTWARD INTO NORTHERN LAKE MICHIGAN. WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...THIS APPEARS LIKELY TO PROGRESS INTO NORTHERN PORTIONS OF LOWER MICHIGAN...WHERE THE BOUNDARY LAYER APPEARS TO BE DESTABILIZING ONCE AGAIN IN THE WAKE OF EARLIER CONVECTION. GIVEN STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR BENEATH 50-60 KT WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW ACROSS THIS REGION...INSTABILITY PROBABLY WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR FURTHER CONVECTIVE GROWTH AND INTENSIFICATION. ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WITH PERHAPS SOME UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A SMALL ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTER MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION DURING THE 19-23Z TIME FRAME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE WEATHER WATCH PROBABLY WILL BE NEEDED BY THE 21-22Z TIME FRAME...IF NOT BEFORE...AS ONGOING STORMS ACROSS ONTARIO AND QUEBEC CONTINUE TO INTENSIFY AND APPROACH THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITHIN A BROADLY CONFLUENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW...THE EVOLUTION OF AN ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM APPEARS UNDERWAY ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHERN ONTARIO INTO SOUTHERN QUEBEC. THIS IS GENERALLY OCCURRING ON THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF A BELT OF 50 KT DEEP LAYER WESTERLY MEAN FLOW...IN THE PRESENCE OF THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY RELATIVELY HIGH PRECIPITABLE WATER...STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SIZABLE CAPE. BASED ON AVAILABLE CAPPI DATA...THE BOWING EASTERN FLANK OF THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM APPEARS TO BE MOVING EASTWARD IN EXCESS OF 50 KT...AND COULD IMPACT THE MOUNTAINS OF WESTERN MAINE NEAR OR SHORTLY AFTER 22Z. AROUND THE SAME TIME...IT APPEARS THE WESTERN FLANK OF THE SYSTEM COULD REACH UPSTATE NEW YORK COUNTIES TO THE NORTHEAST OF LAKE ONTARIO...BEFORE ACTIVITY CONTINUES INTO THE CHAMPLAIN VALLEY AND MUCH OF THE REMAINDER OF NORTHERN NEW ENGLAND. SOME HAIL IS POSSIBLE IN STRONGEST STORMS...BUT THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE STRONG...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS,

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN A THREAT OVER MUCH OF LOWER MI THIS EVENING. COVERAGE OF STORMS MAY INCREASE THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR AND SATELLITE LOOPS SUGGEST THAT ONLY ISOLATED INTENSE STORMS ARE OCCURRING AT THIS TIME ACROSS WW 422 OVER LOWER MI...WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS CURRENTLY AFFECTING AREAS JUST NORTHWEST OF DET. THE BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS THE REGION HAS RECOVERED FROM EARLIER STORMS...WITH TEMPERATURES NOW NEAR 90F AND LITTLE INHIBITION REMAINING. THE MAJORITY OF MESOSCALE MODELS INDICATE THAT CONVECTION WILL BECOME MORE NUMEROUS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS THE COLD FRONT SAGS SOUTHWARD AND DEEP MIXING OCCURS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS CONTINUE TO SHOW SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR AND CAPE FOR A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL IN THE STRONGEST CELLS. ..HART.. 07/19/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY BEGIN TO POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS EARLY THIS EVENING ACROSS A PORTION OF WRN NY...MAINLY AFTER 23Z. IT IS NOT CERTAIN YET WHETHER SEVERE THREAT WILL BECOME SUFFICIENT TO WARRANT A WW...BUT TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS EVENING A LINE OF STORMS EXTENDS FROM NRN LAKE ONTARIO SWWD TO NEAR TORONTO WHERE IT INTERSECTS ANOTHER CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE STRONGER STORMS ARE NEAR TORONTO ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTION...WHILE STORMS FARTHER NORTH HAVE WEAKENED AS THEY BEGIN TO MOVE ACROSS NRN LAKE ONTARIO. ACTIVITY IS MOVING ESEWD AT AROUND 35-40 KT...AND SOME OF THE STRONGER STORMS MAY BEGIN TO AFFECT PORTIONS OF WRN NY NEAR BUFFALO AROUND 23Z IF THEY MAINTAIN INTENSITY. VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS WHAT APPEARS TO BE A LAKE BREEZE BOUNDARY FROM SOUTH OF BUFFALO NEWD TO SE OF LAKE ONTARIO. THE ATMOSPHERE SOUTH OF THE LAKE BREEZE IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE TO 2500 J/KG. SOME POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR STORMS CROSSING LAKE ONTARIO TO INTENSIFY AS THEIR ATTENDANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MOVES SEWD AND INTERACTS/MERGES WITH THE LAKE BREEZE BOUNDARY OVER WRN NY. PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS...OCCASIONALLY INTENSE...WILL CONTINUE TO AFFECT PORTIONS OF THE MID ATLANTIC STATES EARLY THIS EVENING. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN DISORGANIZED...WITH WATCH ISSUANCE UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE AFFECTING PORTIONS OF THE MID ATLANTIC REGION...PRIMARILY ALONG A LINE FROM MORGAN/BERKELEY COUNTIES WV NORTHEASTWARD INTO DAUPHIN/LEBANON COUNTIES PA. OTHER MORE ISOLATED CELLS ARE AFFECTING THE AREA BETWEEN WASHINGTON DC AND BALTIMORE. THE BOUNDARY LAYER OVER THIS REGION HAS BECOME VERY UNSTABLE WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW-MID 90S AND MLCAPE VALUES OVER 4000 J/KG. DESPITE THE FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC PARAMETERS... VERTICAL SHEAR AND WINDS ALOFT ARE QUITE WEAK. LATEST LWX VAD SHOWS 6KM SHEAR AOB 15 KNOTS AND WEAK WINDS AT UPPER LEVELS. THIS SHOULD LIMIT CONVECTIVE VENTING AND UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE STRONGEST CELLS MAY BRIEFLY PRODUCE GUSTY TO POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. STORMS SHOULD SLOWLY WEAKEN AFTER 00Z AS DAYTIME HEATING WANES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MOVING FROM NERN NY THROUGH MUCH OF NRN NEW ENGLAND WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND NEXT 2-3 HOURS. SOME STORMS MAY SOON MOVE OUT OF WW 423...ESPECIALLY OVER A PORTION OF NH...AND THE WW CAN BE LOCALLY EXTENDED AS NECESSARY. SEVERE THREAT IN THIS REGION SHOULD BEGIN A DECREASING TREND TOWARD LATE EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER BEGINS TO COOL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CONTINUE DEVELOPING ALONG AN EXPANSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS FROM FAR EAST MAINE WWD THROUGH NRN VT AND NERN NY. THE PART OF THE LINE OVER NRN VT IS ORIENTED NE-SW WITH A LARGER COMPONENT NORMAL TO THE MEAN DEEP LAYER WIND...WHILE STORMS FARTHER EAST IN MAINE ARE ORIENTED PARALLEL TO THE MEAN FLOW. MONTAGUE VWP SHOWS 50+ KT WLY FLOW IN THE 1-6 KM LAYER...AND STORMS ARE MOVING ESEWD AT 40-45 KT. ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE IN WARM SECTOR...AND STRONGER STORMS WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS NEXT 2-3 HOURS. SEVERE THREAT MAY BE GREATEST INITIALLY FROM NERN VT THROUGH NRN NH AND EVENTUALLY WRN MAINE WITHIN ZONE OF ENHANCED CONVERGENCE WHERE THE EWD MOVING NE-SW ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTS THE E-W BOUNDARY. ..DIAL.. 07/20/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND WILL PERSIST NEXT 2-3 HOURS OVER MUCH OF THE SRN HALF OF NY. SOME STORMS ARE APPROACHING THE SRN END OF WW 424...AND THE WW CAN BE LOCALLY EXTENDED IN AREA TO INCLUDE ANOTHER COUPLE ROWS OF COUNTIES. OTHER STORMS MAY POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT FOR NERN OH INTO NWRN PA NEXT COUPLE HOURS...BUT DURATION OF THIS THREAT IS NOT EXPECTED TO BE SUFFICIENT FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE UNDERGONE SOME INCREASE IN INTENSITY FROM WRN THROUGH ECNTRL NY...PRIMARILY WITHIN ZONE OF ENHANCED CONVERGENCE RESULTING FROM MERGING OF AN EXPANSIVE ESEWD ADVANCING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WITH THE PRE-EXISTING LAKE BREEZE. THE 00Z RAOB FROM BUFFALO SHOWS WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR BUT 40-45 KT WLY WINDS BETWEEN 1 AND 8 KM. MUCH OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE SEGMENTS ARE PARALLEL TO THE DEEP LAYER WINDS WHICH IS A LIMITING FACTOR TO SOME DEGREE FOR A MORE ROBUST SEVERE WIND EVENT. NEVERTHELESS...SOME OF THE STRONGER STORMS WITHIN THE LINE WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AS THEY DEVELOP ESEWD. LINE OF STORMS APPROACHING NRN LAKE ERIE IS ORIENTED NEARLY PERPENDICULAR TO THE MEAN FLOW AND APPEARS TO HAVE A BOWING STRUCTURE ON ITS NRN END. THIS ACTIVITY MIGHT POSE A SEVERE THREAT AS IT MOVES INTO WRN NY. HOWEVER...OUTFLOW FROM THE E-W BAND OF STORMS DOWNSTREAM IS SETTLING SWD AND SHOULD TEND TO UNDERCUT THIS LINE...SUGGESTING IT MIGHT WEAKEN AS IT MOVES BEYOND THE ERN SHORE OF LAKE ERIE. OTHER STORMS MOVING SEWD THROUGH CNTRL LAKE ERIE MAY POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND FROM NERN OH INTO NWRN PA. HOWEVER...THESE STORMS ARE MOVING SOUTH OF THE STRONGER WINDS ALOFT AND SHOULD BEGIN A WEAKENING TREND AFTER ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER BEGINS TO COOL. ..DIAL.. 07/20/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL PERSIST OVER PORTIONS OF LOWER MI FOR ANOTHER FEW HOURS. WW 422 IS SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 02Z...AND MAY NEED TO BE LOCALLY EXTENDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COLD FRONT CONTINUES TO SAG SLOWLY SOUTHWARD ACROSS NORTH CENTRAL LOWER MI. SEVERAL INTENSE STORMS ARE ALONG THE BOUNDARY...OVER MECOSTA/OSCEOLA/CLARE/GLADWIN/OGEMAW/IOSCO COUNTIES. THIS ACTIVITY IS MOVING EASTWARD AT 35 KNOTS AND WILL MOVE OFFSHORE BETWEEN 3-4Z. OTHER THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL BOUNDARY OVER SOUTHERN LAKE MI. SOME POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR THESE STORMS TO INTENSIFY TO SEVERE LEVELS AS WELL. RELATIVELY STRONG INSTABILITY AND FAVORABLE VERTICAL SHEAR SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS /LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/ FOR A FEW MORE HOURS ACROSS THE WATCH AREA. THEREFORE...PORTIONS OF WW 422 MAY REQUIRE LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME. ..HART.. 07/20/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PLAN IS TO ALLOW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH TO EXPIRE AT 03Z. HOWEVER...SOME SEVERE THREAT MAY CONTINUE FOR AN HOUR OR SO BEYOND 03Z FROM A PORTION OF SRN NH INTO SRN MAINE...AND WW CAN BE LOCALLY EXTENDED IN TIME IF NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS EXTENDS FROM SRN MAINE WWD INTO SRN VT AND ECNTRL NY. STORMS ARE MOVING GENERALLY EWD AT AROUND 40 KT AND WILL HAVE CLEARED MOST OF THE REMAINING COUNTIES IN WW 423 BY 03Z. SOME SEVERE THREAT MAY LINGER UNTIL 04Z OVER A SMALL PORTION FOR SRN NH INTO SRN MAINE. ..DIAL.. 07/20/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 424 WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z. SOME THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST UNTIL AROUND 05Z...BUT OVERALL THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CONTINUE EWD ACROSS SRN NY ALONG A RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT IS MOVING SLOWLY SWD. OVERALL TREND HAS BEEN FOR ACTIVITY TO SLOWLY WEAKEN AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS...AND THIS TREND IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE NEXT COUPLE HOURS. ..DIAL.. 07/20/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS NORTH OF PHX MAY PROPAGATE SOUTHWESTWARD INTO PORTIONS OF THE LOWER DESERTS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME DUE TO LIMITED AREAL COVERAGE OF THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR LOOPS SHOW A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF NORTHERN GILA COUNTY. THESE STORMS ARE PROPAGATING SOUTHWESTWARD AT 25-30 KNOTS AND WILL BEGIN SPREADING INTO LOWER ELEVATIONS DURING THE NEXT HOUR. RECENT VWP DATA FROM FSX AND IWA SHOW EASTERLY/EAST-NORTHEASTERLY MID LEVEL FLOW OF 15-25 KNOTS THAT WILL HELP STORMS TO MOVE INTO THE LOWER DESERTS...WHILE THE 00Z PSR RAOB SHOWED A DEEP MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND PWAT VALUES OF 1.65 INCHES FAVORABLE FOR CONVECTIVE MAINTENANCE. THE AREA MOST LIKELY TO SEE STRONG AND LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS WOULD APPEAR TO BE PARTS OF SOUTHERN YAVAPAI AND NORTHERN MARICOPA COUNTY. THIS MIGHT INCLUDE THE NORTHERN PORTIONS OF THE PHOENIX AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS HAS DEVELOPED OVER NORTHWEST SD. THESE STORMS MAY PERSIST FOR A FEW HOURS AND DRIFT EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD...POSING A RISK OF HAIL IN THE STRONGER CORES. A WW IN UNLIKELY...BUT WE WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR TRENDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A CLUSTER OF INTENSIFYING THUNDERSTORMS OVER PARTS OF NEWELL/STURGIS COUNTIES SD. THESE STORMS APPEAR TO BE FORMING AS A LOW LEVEL JET SLOWLY STRENGTHENS OVER THE REGION...RESULTING IN ENHANCED WARM ADVECTION. THE UDX VAD PROFILE SHOWS RATHER STRONG NORTHWEST FLOW AT MID/UPPER LEVELS...PROVIDING FAVORABLE DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR. MUCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG WILL SUPPORT A RISK OF ROTATING UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS. AT THIS TIME IT APPEARS THAT THE THREAT WILL REMAIN QUITE LIMITED IN AREAL EXTENT. HOWEVER...SOME 00Z MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS STORMS MAY PERSIST THROUGHOUT THE NIGHT AND TRACK INTO EASTERN SD BEFORE MORNING. IF THIS OCCURS...AND IF STORMS CAN ORGANIZE INTO AN MCS...THE POTENTIAL WOULD EXIST FOR A WATCH IN A FEW HOURS.
